notes.content:

April 01, 2025 update note

the update includes a character correction and creature mob balancing in the game i replaced the uzi weapon with a shotgun it will be easier to use because the uzi was too cheater.

notes.title: An improved version
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3081330/extras/Astec_Eperimental__1_.gif?t=1738670738[/img]

fixed the grass-too-tall bug made available for better visibility, added tilesets to the map and then the jetpack was made available again in the city of bythzkel, I must warn you that the game is in the construction phase and will soon be made available to the game to accompany the astec experimental dlc.

notes.title: Major game update.
notes.content:
[b]The beginning of my game is my own creation.

Thank you for your interest in my game. I don't know how to thank you for your support, which makes my life so much better. Thank you for playing and having fun. For example, I make sure that you can have fun and do what you want to do (today I've incorporated a menu system into my game so that players can customize their gameplay.)
Thank you for advertising me, it means a lot to me to be able to continue to provide you with regular content.[/b]
